data.name: Sager
data.gender_notes: Sager is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sager derives from the Sanskrit word 'Saraswati' which means 'Goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning'. Saraswati is often depicted holding a veena, a stringed musical instrument, which represents the harmonious vibration of the universe. The name Sager is a modern variation of the name Saraswati and is given to children to bless them with the qualities of a healer and a protector.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sager is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality and represents the divine power of knowledge, wisdom, and healing. It is believed that the name carries the blessings of the Goddess Saraswati, who is the embodiment of all forms of knowledge and creativity. Children named Sager are believed to have a deep connection with their spiritual side and are often drawn to creative pursuits, healing practices, and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Sager belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Healer, Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sager total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
